stable.notes: Parts Database fixes reported by OBR: the Save / Discard / Cancel prompt of a new device no longer comes back after every Cancel (nor nests inside Save, nor lets Discard load the first device over the new one); a terminal, housing or other part saved, renamed or deleted under Connector Parts reaches the Connectors tab's dropdowns at once (no restart or Reload needed), a wire saved reaches the Functions tab's Default Wire list, a function saved reaches the Devices tab.
